scope: isolated dedicated reminder read mode; no default Avatar integration or ordinary chat equivalence
base_reader: avatar.lab.trusted_local_read.LabReadSession; preserve C41 source/execute/publish and startup transaction guards

function.name: read_reminder_state
function.description: 只读查询一个本机提醒编号的当前记录；不创建、认领、ACK或保证真人阅读。

function.name: read_reminder_delivery_policy
function.description: 读取当前本机提醒运行与送达条件；可核验服务退出、网页在线轮询及外部通道的限制。

function.name: clarify_reminder_reference
function.description: 当前用户询问某条提醒的状态，但没有唯一有效编号或可信已选对象时，请求补充编号；不读取记录或运行条件，不执行业务动作。运行和送达条件问题本身无需提醒编号。

variants.full: advertise original2 state/policy tools, no source availability filtering/const; executor source guard still applies
variants.eligible_bound: filter by actual source parameter preconditions, add state reminder_id const when unique eligible ID; no clarification function
variants.eligible_complete: same eligible_bound plus clarification function when reminder domain allowed and no unique eligible ID; fixed main candidate

source_catalogue.entry: session.ensure_current and actual private current-turn token; refuse active caller transaction before planning/model waits
source_catalogue.identity: live session/turn object plus message_id/session/revision/source text SHA; metadata never acts as a serialized authorization token
source_catalogue.state_eligibility: visible unquoted/non-code finite ID candidate + C41 parameter_basis(text,{reminder_id:n},read_reminder_state) passes; no business row is read to decide existence
source_catalogue.state_binding: eligible variants retain declared integer/min/max/required/additionalProperties schema and add const=n; actual execution independently rejects bool/float/string/wrong ID/extra fields
source_catalogue.clarification_eligibility: policy source/domain/exclusion gate passes and no unique source-eligible ID; not a claim semantic intent is known
source_catalogue.catalogue_mutability: immutable serialized schemas; tools accessor returns a copy; bind/freshness checked before and after model inference; no held read transaction
source_catalogue.registry_validation: exact3 known function names, no duplicate names, expected parameter shapes; baseline selects only legacy2; no write tool or model-provided registry accepted

clarification_action.result_kind: reference_clarification, distinct from successful data read or validation failure
clarification_action.reply: 请明确要查询的提醒编号；当前没有唯一编号，这次未读取提醒记录。
clarification_action.guards: actual current source/role/independent permission, domain/exclusion/missing ID; current valid ID makes missing-reference clarification ineligible; source/epoch changes cancel
clarification_action.publication: same service-issued latest result identity and fresh-source/released-transaction boundary as base reader

no_eligible_tools: eligible variants publish fixed no-read clarification under source authority, skip model; count framework rule cases separately, never model successes
model_no_tool_or_invalid: preserve raw text/proposal/error in evidence, publish fixed no-read response; no unverified model text presented as data; malformed/unavailable output separately counted and never business-dispatched
task_scope: dedicated read-mode only; does not preserve ordinary creative-writing/greeting behavior; default normal chat is unchanged
CPU_controls_required: policy/no-ID source offers policy only vs policy+clarifier; no forced policy execution
bound ID state/policy const, no-existence-probe on missing row ID
quoted/code/negated/writing/multiple-ID/invalid-ID finite source filters, clarify only eligible
clone schemas cannot mutate catalogue; bad registry/type/name/extra parameters rejected
catalogue cannot hold caller transaction across inference
clarification has no business SQL/write/ACK/receipt and remains distinct from read success
clarification false for explicit ID, invalid params rejected; stale publication and old result identity rejected
gold poisoning changes only scores, never catalogue/execution
raw unsupported function/XML and no-tool false assurance withheld with honest no-read result
execution_authority: separate immutable descriptor only after CPU/current software/runtime admission; this registration is not an execution token
